What should I do if the tracking never updates?
If your tracking information hasn't updated after receiving a shipping confirmation, carriers may sometimes take 24 to 48 hours to scan the package into their system once it leaves the warehouse.
If several days pass without any updates or if your delivery date passes, please let us know! We can reach out to the carrier or check on your shipment directly to get an update on your package.

turns.q: Can I reroute the package to a different address?
turns.replyTail:
e package to a different address?
menu
Yes, changing the shipping address after an order has shipped is sometimes possible, but it depends on the carrier and status of the delivery.
If we are able to request a reroute with the carrier, please note that any additional address change fees or freight charges assessed by the carrier will apply.
To request an address change, please contact us in writing with your order details and the new delivery address so our team can contact the carrier for you!
